subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

They will send Madhu away to a boarding school.

options.text: Madhu will be sent away to a boarding school by them.
Madhu will send away to a boarding school by them.
Madhu shall be sent away to a boarding school by them.
Madhu will have been sent away to a boarding school by them.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Madhu will be sent away to a boarding school by them'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the Active Voice is changed into the object of the Passive voice. Also, the object of the Active Voice is changed into the subject of the Passive Voice.
 
• The usage of a helping verb is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from Active to Passive.
